title.value: Assessing the impact of aircraft arrival on ambient ultrafine particle number concentrations in near-airport communities in Boston, Massachusetts
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: Assessing the impact of aircraft arrival on ambient ultrafine particle number concentrations in near-airport communities in Boston, Massachusetts

extractions.description: The study evaluates the impact of arrival aircraft on particle number concentration (PNC), a proxy for UFP, across six study sites 3–17 km from a major arrival aircraft flight path into Boston Logan International Airport by utilizing real-time aircraft activity and meteorological data. The findings suggest strong but intermittent contributions from arrival aircraft to ambient PNC in communities near airports.
